page.layout: One printed page, blank. Only manuscript writing at the top, which is not printed and is left out.
page.notes: The page carries no printed text. At the top is a handwritten inscription ("Leonhardy Walberg") and a handwritten entry below it, with a ruled line, recording the death of a brother on 1 July, apparently in the year 1629 ("3.6.2.9"), "apud patrem", "Aet. 17", "pastor". This is manuscript annotation, not print, so it is omitted from the transcription. The rest of the page is blank, apart from a few stains and show-through.
